about: State of Muse's aggregation work across the four sports, drawn as the Visual Dashboard's aggregation web. Maintained by the strategic window at every wave close from the archive (eignacio1/sports-intel-archive, commit below), TO_MUSE.md and the bot repo. built = delivered and in the repo/archive; pending = a ticket or block open now; future = planned, no ticket yet. Operator 2026-10-21 08:11 PT: 'give us an idea of pending, built, future'.
